info.title: Postcode Context - Great Britain Demographics & Property Intelligence API
info.description: Give AI agents real-world Great Britain location intelligence. High-performance, 100% stateless Great Britain postcode context API and Remote MCP Server running on Cloudflare Workers edge nodes. Turn any postcode into structured property, demographic, energy, school, healthcare, and connectivity context in one call. Covers England, Scotland, and Wales (Northern Ireland BT postcodes strictly excluded to avoid proprietary PAF or LPS fees). Unifies 19 statutory open datasets: ONS Census 2021, ONSPD 2026, Ordnance Survey OS OpenData, Royal Mail Gridlink allocation, HM Land Registry 3-year rolling transactions (2024–2026), Registers of Scotland property transactions (2023–2025), Open EPC domestic register, Scottish EPC Register, English Indices of Deprivation (IoD 2025), Welsh WIMD 2025, Scottish SIMD 2020v2, Ofcom Connected Nations 2026 broadband, DfE Get Information About Schools (GIAS), Care Quality Commission (CQC) healthcare registries, Scottish/Welsh schools directories, NHS Scotland/Wales directories, NaPTAN transit nodes, and ORR station footfall. Features pre-synthesised AI affluence scores, multi-criteria comparisons, and dense context briefings. Settle per-request via x402 v2 (USDC on Base Mainnet eip155:8453). Active baseline v2026.10 updated October 2026. Not for credit, insurance, lending, employment, or tenant-screening decisions.

x402Auth.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402Auth.description: x402 v2 payment signature for on-chain USDC micropayments on Base Mainnet (eip155:8453). Rates: $0.005/postcode, $0.010/compare, $0.050/batch, $0.005/outcode.

ai_context_briefing.description: Pre-synthesised dense natural language summary designed for LLM context window injection

primary_persona_tag.description: Target marketing and socio-economic persona archetype

affluence_tier.description: Categorical socio-economic bracket segmenting Great Britain residential neighbourhoods into 5 macro cohorts

b2c_spending_propensity.description: Inferred neighbourhood consumer expenditure profile derived from local affluence tier and tenure. Represents a macro area characteristic, not an observed financial record of an individual household.

affluence_score_100.description: Composite socio-economic score from 1 to 100 (weighted: 35% modelled income, 25% human capital qualifications/NS-SeC, 25% IMD deprivation freedom, 15% homeownership equity; ~10 points represents ~1 national decile shift)

family_suitability_score_100.description: Composite family suitability score from 1 to 100 (weighted: 40% statutory crime safety decile, 30% statutory education/skills deprivation decile, 30% child and parenting-age demographic density)

commuter_connectivity_score_100.description: Composite multi-modal connectivity score from 1 to 100 (evaluating straight-line geodesic distance to nearest rail/rapid transit station, strategic intercity hub tier, zero-car transit reliance density, broadband speed tier, and affluence)

property_value_index.description: Relative property valuation index benchmarked against prime central London baseline (£16,200/sqm ceiling = 100)

median_house_price_gbp.description: HM Land Registry (E&W 2024–2026) and Registers of Scotland (Scotland 2023–2025) 3-year rolling median transaction price in GBP (nullable for 0-transaction areas)

price_per_sqm_gbp.description: Synthetic property valuation benchmark joining 3-year rolling median transaction prices (HMLR / RoS) with domestic mean internal floor areas (Open EPC / Scottish EPC Register) at postcode level (nullable if no EPC or sales recorded)

resolution.description: Spatial granularity of the median property valuation

window.description: Rolling temporal transaction window (2024–2026 for England & Wales, 2023–2025 for Scotland)

n.description: Number of recorded transactions in rolling window used to compute median price

crime_safety_decile.description: Statutory Crime Deprivation Decile (1-10) from the English IoD 2025, Welsh WIMD 2025, and Scottish SIMD 2020 (1 = highest recorded crime deprivation nationally, 10 = lowest recorded crime deprivation / safest 10%). Sourced from multi-year police records per capita at LSOA level. Represents neighbourhood historical baseline, not individual personal victimisation risk.

est_median_household_income_gbp.description: Heuristic small-area estimate of annual median gross disposable household income in GBP (LSOA/Data Zone level) derived from a linear formula weighting DWP/HMRC income deprivation deciles, Census NS-SeC managerial occupation shares, and Level 4 qualifications, clamped at £21,000–£95,000. Not an observed Census return.

broadband_speed_tier_mbps.description: Estimated fixed broadband download speed tier in Mbps (350, 120, 80, or 68.5 Mbps baseline derived from Ofcom Connected Nations availability brackets)

median_download_mbps.description: Legacy backwards-compatibility alias for broadband_speed_tier_mbps (modelled Ofcom availability tier, not an observed speed-test median)

is_national_landmark.description: True if this postcode represents a major national landmark, royal palace, civic seat, or special non-geographic entity

demographic_distortion_note.example: Census demographics reflect residential blocks in Westminster 018C (Wellington Barracks and rental flats towards Victoria), not the Royal Household.

hub_type.description: Station hierarchy classification based on ORR annual passenger footfall: national_hub (>=10M/yr or Cat A), regional_hub (>=2M/yr or Cat B), commuter_hub (500k-2M/yr), or local_station (<500k/yr).

nearest_station.description: Closest rail, metro, or tram stop of any category

nearest_intercity_hub.description: Closest primary mainline intercity railway hub (>= 2M annual passengers or Network Rail Category A/B interchange)

BillingReceipt.description: Settled on-chain transaction receipt metadata under x402 payment specifications

PostcodeIntelligenceResponse.description: Comprehensive Great Britain postcode socio-economic profile. Sliced views prune optional metric blocks to optimize LLM context window token efficiency: full (complete 113-metric profile, default), brief/summary/ai (summary_for_ai, location, _attribution, _licensing, _billing, ~80 tokens), property (property_and_energy, digital_infrastructure), demographics (deprivation_deciles, census_demographics), education (schools_and_education), healthcare (healthcare_and_services), transit (transit), or services (education, healthcare, transit, digital_infrastructure). The _attribution property is strictly required and preserved across all view slices in accordance with statutory Open Government Licence v3.0, Ordnance Survey OpenData, and Crown copyright requirements.

match_type.description: Resolution accuracy: exact_unit (matched unit postcode in directory) or district_fallback (aggregated outcode postal district profile)

requested_postcode.description: Normalized display representation of the requested postcode

resolved_district.description: Outward postal district code if fallback was applied (null on exact unit matches)

note.example: Exact unit postcode not yet in Census/ONS directory. Returning aggregated SW1A district profile.
note.description: Explanatory contextual note for fallback profiles (null on exact unit matches)

_attribution.description: Official statutory Crown copyright and Open Government Licence v3.0 attribution statement (mandatory across all views)

update_cadence.example: Monthly active refresh (HMLR, RoS & EPC); Quarterly (ONSPD); Periodic (Census & IMD)

OutcodeSummaryResponse.description: District-wide demographic, housing valuation, and socio-economic aggregation across all registered postcodes in a Great Britain outward postal district (e.g. BB7, SW1A, EH1, CF10).

outcode.description: Outward postal district code (e.g. BB7, SW1A, EH1, CF10)

total_postcodes.description: Total number of live registered unit postcodes aggregated within this outward district

district_median_house_price_gbp.description: District-wide median residential transaction price in GBP from 3-year rolling sales (HMLR / RoS)

district_avg_price_per_sqm_gbp.description: District-wide mean transaction price per internal square metre in GBP

average_affluence_score_100.description: District-wide mean composite affluence score on a 1–100 scale

dominant_affluence_tier.description: Most common affluence tier across unit postcodes within the district

imd_overall_decile_range.description: Spread of statutory Index of Multiple Deprivation deciles across constituent neighborhoods within the district (1 = most deprived 10% nationally, 10 = least deprived / safest 10%)

min.description: Lowest (most deprived) IMD decile recorded in any constituent LSOA or Data Zone in this district

max.description: Highest (least deprived) IMD decile recorded in any constituent LSOA or Data Zone in this district

top_personas.description: Ranked list of dominant demographic and socio-economic persona archetypes in the district

district_context_briefing.example: Outward postal district BB7 encompasses 1420 registered postcode sector areas in Ribble Valley (North West). Baseline property values median at £358,398 (£2,480/sqm) with composite district affluence scored at 62/100 (Mid-Market). IMD deprivation ranges from decile 3 to 10.

get.summary: Get Great Britain Postcode Intelligence Profile
get.description: Returns full demographic, housing market, EPC energy efficiency, broadband, and deprivation indices for a single Great Britain postcode (England, Scotland, Wales). Normalises input automatically (accepts space, compact SW1A1AA, or URL-encoded + / %20).

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Great Britain postcode (e.g. SW1A 1AA, BB7 3BB, EH1 1YZ, CF10 1EP). Accepts spaces, no spaces (SW1A1AA), or URL-encoded (+ / %20). Northern Ireland (BT) postcodes excluded.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Slice target view: full (complete dataset, default), brief (or summary/ai, ~80 tokens brief), property (valuations & EPC), demographics (Census & IMD deciles), education (nearest schools & proximity), healthcare (nearest GP surgery), transit (rail & metro), or services (education, healthcare, transit & digital connectivity)

parameters.name: exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated domains to exclude from payload: schools, healthcare, transit (e.g. exclude=schools,healthcare,transit)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export format: json (default), flat, csv, or markdown/md (GitHub Flavored Markdown)

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: Base64-encoded settlement receipt confirming on-chain USDC payment execution (x402Version, transaction hash, network, and payer wallet)
